adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, a token refresh is now performed unconditionally during connection construction: it immediately `fetch`es `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` using the stored `refresh_token` and then does `prisma.credential.update(...)` to rewrite the credential key before returning `new jsforce.Connection(...)`. There is no check for whether the existing `credential.key.access_token` is still valid/expired, so every service instantiation incurs a network round-trip and DB write. It also hard-fails all Salesforce operations on any transient refresh failure via `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)`, even if the cached access token could still work.
